name: mcp-image
description: Resize, convert, compress, crop, thumbnail and watermark images from chat: no upload, no account, no native dependency. Every file stays on your machine.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: image_info
tools.description: Format, pixel dimensions, megapixels, file size in bytes and whether the image carries an alpha channel. Read-only: the file is never modified. Free tier: unlimited, at any size.

tools.name: image_resize
tools.description: Write a resized copy. fit: "inside" scales to fit the box and keeps the aspect ratio; "cover" fills the box and crops the overflow; "exact" stretches to the given width and height. With only one of width or height, the other follows the aspect ratio. The input is never modified. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_convert
tools.description: Re-encode an image as PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF or TIFF. quality is a JPEG parameter only and is reported as ignored for the lossless formats. Converting an image with transparency to JPEG flattens it onto white, and the answer says so. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_compress
tools.description: Re-encode an image smaller and report the byte count before and after. quality (default 80) applies when the output is a JPEG; for a PNG output only max_width reduces bytes, and the answer says which of the two did the work. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_crop
tools.description: Cut a rectangle out of an image. x and y are the top-left corner in pixels, counted from the top-left of the image. A rectangle that runs past an edge is refused with the image's real size, never silently clamped. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_thumbnails
tools.description: One thumbnail per input, written into out_dir as <name>-thumb.<ext>. Each thumbnail fits inside size by size and keeps its aspect ratio, so a wide photo stays wide. Every output path is reserved before any file is written, so a collision does not leave a half-done batch. Free tier: up to 5 files per call and sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_watermark
tools.description: Draw text over an image at a chosen corner and opacity. With no text the shared business profile name is used, the same profile mcp-invoice and mcp-docx write. The text is drawn white on a translucent dark plate so it stays legible on a light photo. Free tier: the profile name; Pro: any text you pass.

tools.name: image_strip_metadata
tools.description: Write a copy carrying pixels and nothing else. It works by decoding the image and re-encoding it from the raw pixels: EXIF, GPS coordinates, the camera and lens, the capture time, XMP and colour-profile blocks are not carried across, because the encoder writes only what it is given. The pixels are the same; the bytes are not. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_batch_resize
tools.description: Resize every image into out_dir, keeping each one's aspect ratio, named <name>-<W>x<H>.<ext>. With one of width or height the other follows; with both, each image is scaled to fit inside that box. Free tier: up to 5 files per call and sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_dominant_colors
tools.description: The colours that cover most of an image, as hex codes with the share of pixels each one covers, for picking a background or a brand palette. Read-only. Free tier: the top 3 colours; Pro: up to 16.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
